newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BRAMBLES SAYS KNOWS NO REASON FOR RISE.
newsitem.headline: BRAMBLES SAYS KNOWS NO REASON FOR RISE.

text.p: Transport and logistics group Brambles Industries Ltd said on Friday it knew of no reason for a recent rise in its share price.
Brambles shares rose to a record high of A$29.40 on Thursday from a low of A$27.69 on Wednesday.
Responding to an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) query, Brambles said it was in compliance with listing rules and the market was fully informed.
On Thursday, brokers told Reuters the release of results by GKN Plc, Brambles' partner in the Chep pallet business in the United States, had sparked the surge in the stock.
GKN said in London on Wednesday that the Chep profit grew 31 percent at constant exchange rates.
Brambles shares closed Thursday A$1.128 higher at A$29.108.
